post.summary: Read masked email and role for a valid administrator invitation
post.description: Exact approved Origin, trusted network context and strict 4 KiB JSON. Requires possession of the active unexpired invitation token, including named invitation snapshots. Returns only masked email and the saved role key; never returns full identity, registers accounts, consumes invitations or grants access. Tokens belong in POST bodies, not query strings. Response is private/no-store.

token.description: Opaque invitation link context plus its six-digit code, or a legacy strong token. Bare six digits are never authority.

setup_state.description: Only disclosed after valid invitation proof. SET_PASSWORD includes eligible unfinished UNASSIGNED identities even when an earlier attempt already saved a password; it does not claim administrator access is active.
